# Notation Coach — llms.txt

> A daily chess-notation trainer with practice sets and a streak counter.
> This file is written for an assistant (Muse, Grok, ChatGPT, Claude, any agent with a scheduler)
> so it can send one useful daily reminder and understand the user's progress. Human-readable,
> plain text, no auth. Last updated with the drill build of 2026-11-15.

## Site

- App: https://chess-notation-coach.vercel.app/
- Today's set: https://chess-notation-coach.vercel.app/#/today
- Set for any date: https://chess-notation-coach.vercel.app/#/day/YYYY-MM-DD
- Force a theme for one session: https://chess-notation-coach.vercel.app/#/day/YYYY-MM-DD?theme=knight
- Streak + history: https://chess-notation-coach.vercel.app/#/streak
- Notation cheat sheet: https://chess-notation-coach.vercel.app/#/tricks
- Source: https://github.com/mattjliu/Notation-Trainer (MIT) — this build adds daily sets, streaks and this file.
- Build log: https://chess-notation-coach.vercel.app/builder-log.txt

## What the user is doing

An adult improver who can read algebraic notation but slowly — they still translate square by square.
The app drills four things:

1. `grid` — click a named square on an empty board (corners and centre first), or say light/dark.
2. `knight` — click every square a knight can reach from the marked square.
3. `read` — SAN to plain English ("Nxe5+" = "Knight takes e5, check"), and the reverse.
4. `play` — a real position from a world championship game: read the move, then make it on the board.

## Streak rules (state these accurately)

- A day keeps the streak once the user has answered **10 reps** (goal is configurable on the Streak page).
- Wrong answers still count as reps; they are repeated at the end of the set. Nothing is punitive.
- Missing a day resets the streak to zero. The next day starts at 1.
- Progress is stored in the browser's localStorage only. There is no account and no server-side state.
- A bot therefore **cannot read the streak**. Two supported ways to track it (see below).

## Theme rotation (so your reminder can name the right thing)

The app picks the day's theme itself. If you want to know or override it:
`day_index = floor(Date.UTC(y, m-1, d) / 86400000)`, `theme = [grid, capture, knight, check, castle, full, speed][day_index % 7]`.
Valid themes: `grid | capture | knight | check | castle | full | speed`.
Safest: just link `/#/day/<date>` and let the app decide; it also adapts to the user's weakest drill.

## Daily reminder job — prompt to give the bot

Copy everything between the lines into the assistant's system prompt or a scheduled task:

---
You remind me to practise chess notation once a day, at the time I set. Keep it to one message, under 90 words.

Each day:
1. Compute today's date (YYYY-MM-DD) in my timezone.
2. Send me: my streak, today's theme, the rep count, and this link: https://chess-notation-coach.vercel.app/#/day/<date>
3. Add one line of real coaching, rotating through these three tricks by weekday:
   - Trick 1 (grid): corners a1, h1, a8, h8 first, then the centre d4 e4 d5 e5. Squares are names, not coordinates.
   - Trick 2 (knight): every knight move is 2 files + 1 rank, or 1 file + 2 ranks. Learn the eight-square fan once.
   - Trick 3 (chunks): read "knight to f3", never "N - f - 3". Read the tail first: + means check, # means mate, x means takes.
4. If I say DONE, log that day. If I say SKIPPED or go quiet, do not nag more than once; tell me the streak resets.

Tracking: keep your own count of days I confirmed. If I paste an export code (from the Streak page), decode it and use the real numbers instead. Never invent a streak number — if you don't know it, say "unknown" and ask me for the export code.
---

## Message template

> 🔥 Streak {N} · today is {THEME} day — {REPS} reps, about {MINUTES} min.
> {LINK}
> {ONE TRICK LINE}
> Say DONE when it's finished (or paste your export code and I'll verify it).

Example for a first session:

> 🔥 No streak yet — day 1 counts from today.
> Grid day: 16 reps, about 5 min — corners first (a1, h1, a8, h8), then the centre.
> https://chess-notation-coach.vercel.app/#/day/2026-11-15
> Say DONE when it's finished.

## Reading an export code (real streak verification)

On the Streak page the user can press "Generate export code". It is base64 of this JSON:

```json
{
  "v": 1,
  "goal": 10,
  "days": {
    "2026-11-15": { "attempted": 16, "correct": 14, "ms": 184000, "sets": 1,
                    "types": { "square": {"attempted":8,"correct":8}, "knight": {"attempted":4,"correct":4}, "read": {"attempted":4,"correct":2} } }
  }
}
```

Streak = walk back from today while `attempted >= goal` (if today is under goal, the streak is still alive
from yesterday but unbroken only once today is finished). Best streak = longest run of such days.

## Overriding a day's set (optional)

Sets can be pinned by editing `src/data/coach-feed.json` in the repo and redeploying:

```json
{
  "2026-11-20": {
    "headline": "Knight day, 22 reps",
    "why": "You have missed two knight reps in a row — pattern work beats volume today.",
    "theme": "knight",
    "targetReps": 22,
    "tip": "Say each destination out loud before you click it."
  }
}
```

Valid themes only. For a one-off override without deploying, use the `?theme=` link form.

## Drill data

Positions come from 944 world championship games (1886–2018). Pools: capture 220, check 160,
castle 70, promotion 42, knight 220, disambiguation 110, quiet 200, plus 400 SAN-reading items.
Every set is deterministic for a date, so the same link is the same practice tomorrow.

## Etiquette for agents

- One reminder per day. Never send a second nudge on the same day.
- Never claim a streak you did not read from an export code or a confirmed DONE.
- Do not paste whole sets into chat; the app is the practice surface.
- If the user asks how to read notation faster, give the three tricks above, in that order.
